ar: قُلْ يآأَيُّهَا الْكٰفِرُوْنَۙ ۝۱ لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُوْنَۙ ۝۲ وَلَآ أَنْتُمْ عٰبِدُوْنَ مَآ أَعْبُدُۚ ۝۳ وَلَآ أَنَا عَابِدٌ مَّا عَبَدْتُّمْۙ ۝۴ وَلَآ أَنْتُمْ عٰبِدُوْنَ مَآ أَعْبُدُؕ ۝۵ لَكُمْ دِيْنُكُمْ وَلِيَ دِيْنِ ۝۶ ـ سَبْعًا
tr: Qul Yā Ayyuha ‘l-Kafirūn (1) Lā a`budu mā ta`budūn (2) Wa lā antum `ābidūna mā a`bud (3) Wa la ana `ābidum mā `abattum (4) Wa lā antum `ābidūna mā a`bud (5) La kum dīnu kum wa liya dīn (6)
en: In the name of Allah, The Profoundly Merciful, The Continually Merciful

Say: O infidels (1) I worship not what you worship (2) And you are not worshippers of what I worship (3) And I am not a worshipper of what you worship (4) And you are not worshippers of what I worship (5) To you your religion and to me mine! (6) . –7 times.
blocks.review: يآأَيُّهَا: printed as yā (no visible fatḥa) + alif with madda + أَيُّهَا, no dagger alif; transcribed as seen. Pause marks printed over medallions (ۙ on ۱, ۲, ۴; ۚ on ۳; ؕ on ۵) are placed after the preceding word.
